entries.name: Introduction
entries: Every person carries an {@i Alter Ego}: a reflection that lives in the Oniric World, fights in their place, and bears their pain. An {@b Arcan} is someone who has forged a bond with their own Alter, and draws on its power in the material world.

In battle, the Arcan gathers {@b Oniric Charges} by striking and being struck, and spends them to manifest {@b Arcan Aspects}: powers inspired by the many faces of the Major Arcana of the oniric world, which are revealed, inverted, and finally show their {@i True Form}. Their {@b Alter Major} defines their dominant expression and which Major Arcanum is bound to their soul: from the Alter of the Star, who wields a cannon of light, to the Alter of the Devil, who brandishes a golden blade and subjugates everyone with dark forces.
The Arcan is a versatile combatant whose intensity grows as the fight goes on, until they temporarily transform into their own Alter Ego.
